🇲🇽🛢️ <u>SAT cancels invoicing for 2,205 companies caught in the fuel-theft racket</u>

Mexico's tax authority yanked invoicing privileges from 2,205 companies that sold illegal fuel between October 2024 and August 2026 — shell "factureras" that, as Sheinbaum put it, "facturaban combustible cuando, en realidad, no transportaban combustible" (billed for fuel they never actually moved). Add 63 revoked customs-agent permits and a new fuel-traceability database shared across agencies, and customs revenue climbed roughly 250 billion pesos in 2025.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>Mexican truckers shut the Mexicali–Calexico crossing over mass visa cancellations</u>

Mexican cargo drivers blockaded the commercial gate at Mexicali–Calexico this week after Washington pulled roughly 4,000 B1 visas from operators in the region — 17 in a single day, according to Canacar regional delegate Alfonso Millán. Drivers say ICE is hitting them with arbitrary "cabotage" accusations and a new English-proficiency demand, stripping the papers they need to move freight. They warn they'll keep the crossing closed "as long as necessary" and extend it to Tijuana and San Luis Río Colorado if the US won't explain the revocations.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Volkswagen guts 786 jobs at its Puebla plant</u>

Volkswagen just cut 786 workers at its Cuautlancingo plant in Puebla and suspended a full production shift — the first bite of a global plan to shed 50,000 jobs worldwide, approved by its board this week. The 13,000 VW workers in Mexico are learning what "foreign investment" means when Wolfsburg hits a crisis: the newest hires and clause-85 temps go first — 611 fired, 175 pushed into "voluntary" exits. Governor Alejandro Armenta says the state is weighing emergency aid for those let go.

🇲🇽💴 <u>MEXICO RETURNS TO JAPAN'S BOND MARKET</u>

Hacienda placed samurai bonds worth ¥282.8 billion (US$1.77 billion) — Mexico's first yen issuance in two years — in four tranches stretching to 2046, closing its entire 2026 external financing program. Sheinbaum's government diversifies its debt beyond the dollar and locks in long-dated funds on solid demand. Confidence, priced in yen.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>MEXICO'S ARMY GUARDS ITS PEOPLE, NOT AN EMPIRE</u>

The Army and National Guard activated Plan DN-III across Baja California Sur on Sept 1 after severe flooding — clearing roads, rescuing trapped drivers, engineers on permanent alert to prevent worse damage. While Washington deploys troops to hunt migrants and threaten Latin America, Mexico's armed forces serve the people they answer to.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>DECLASSIFIED FILES TIE PAN TO A CATHOLIC FAR-RIGHT NETWORK</u>

Declassified DFS files reveal the Knights of Columbus spent three decades building a network that "linked PAN members with businessmen, Catholic hierarchs and foreign leaders" — among them former PAN national president José González Torres. A 1962 report caught members running electoral brigades for a PAN candidate in Chihuahua. The right's roots, on the record.
banner: FILES TIE PAN TO CATHOLIC FAR-RIGHT

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO'S FOREIGN MINISTER HEADS TO BEIJING</u>

Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco flies to China on Sept 7 to meet Wang Yi and inaugurate a new Mexican consulate in Chongqing — his first trip since taking office. It comes after Mexico's new tariffs cut imports from China 28% in five months, yet both sides keep the door open. Mexico deals with Washington and Beijing on its own terms.

🇲🇽🏥 <u>THE WORLD'S LARGEST DOOR-TO-DOOR HEALTH PROGRAM</u>

20,000 health workers — mostly nurses — have made over 23 million home visits to seniors and people with disabilities, taking vital signs, glucose and cholesterol readings and opening an electronic medical file at every door. Salud Casa por Casa is the biggest program of its kind on earth. Public health that walks to you.

🇲🇽🏠 <u>MEXICO BUILDS HOMES FOR WORKERS, NOT SPECULATORS</u>

Sheinbaum's sexenal goal: 1.8 million homes, reserved for families earning under 2.9 minimum wages. Already 668,000 contracted, 278,000 under construction, 90,000 keys handed to Mexican families. Infonavit and Fovissste — gutted under neoliberalism to bankroll private developers — build public housing again. A right, not a commodity.
